title: Synthetic deployment counts and their denominators
method: Fictional 20-business-day window: 40 deployments, 4 requiring immediate intervention, and 6 unplanned incident-driven rework deployments. Change fail rate = 10%; rework rate = 15%. Subsets can overlap and must not be added. Not observed team results.
alt: Synthetic deployment counts and their denominators. Illustrative values: Total deployments 40 deployments, Failed deployments 4 deployments, Rework deployments 6 deployments.
